note: views_rss_core registers the standard RSS 2.0 channel/item elements via hook_views_rss_channel_elements()/hook_views_rss_item_elements() under namespace 'core', module key 'views_rss_core'. It is a hard dependency of the parent's row plugin (views_rss_fields refuses to save without it, since an item needs title or description). Medium/hard cases target elements unique to this submodule not used in the parent's own eval set: channel <image> and <ttl>, item <enclosure> and <guid>, grounded in real Views config entities (vrss_c_* machine names).

evals.prompt: Why does the views_rss row plugin (views_rss_fields) refuse to save a View unless views_rss_core is enabled?
evals.expected_output: RSS 2.0 requires every item to carry a title or a description, and views_rss_core is the submodule that provides those (and every other core RSS) elements; RssFields::validate() on the row plugin checks views_rss_core is enabled and that at least one of item.core.views_rss_core.title / .description is configured.

evals.prompt: Name at least three RSS <item> elements that the views_rss_core submodule registers via hook_views_rss_item_elements().
evals.expected_output: views_rss_core_views_rss_item_elements() registers title, link, description, author, category, comments, enclosure, guid, pubDate, source, and content:encoded.

evals.prompt: How does views_rss_core derive the channel <lastBuildDate> element, and in what format is it output?
evals.expected_output: views_rss_core_preprocess_views_view_rss() scans every item's pubDate value, takes the most recent one, and sets it as the channel <lastBuildDate> value, formatted via views_rss_format_date() using PHP's RFC-822 date constant.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a View called vrss_c_image with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed style plugin. Inspect its live configuration and report the configured channel <image> path.

This Drupal site has a View called vrss_c_enclosure with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin, mapping some field to the item <enclosure> element. Inspect its live configuration and report which field id is mapped to the enclosure element.

On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_c_ttl with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed style plugin (rss_fields), and set the channel <ttl> element to 45. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_c_ttl has a display whose display_options.style.type is rss_fields and display_options.style.options.channel.core.views_rss_core.ttl is '45'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_c_guid with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin (views_rss_fields), mapping a field called field_vrss_core_guid_src to the item <guid> RSS element. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_c_guid has a display whose display_options.row.type is views_rss_fields and display_options.row.options.item.core.views_rss_core.guid is a non-empty field id.
